title: Household Electricity Reduction for Added Residential Gas Premises
content:
For a premise added to a Residential Natural Gas Supply household, the household electricity reduction depends on the energy charges billed on the customer's Beacon Ridge Residential Electricity Supply lines of cycles starting later than the same calendar day twelve months before the enrollment date: 0.0060 per therm when they total 1200 US dollars or more, 0.0030 per therm when they total 600 or more but below 1200, and none when they total below 600; electricity service fee lines and credits are not counted. The reduction lowers the household rate by that amount per therm.

The records read are the energy charge lines on the customer's Residential Electricity Supply bill ledger, with the billing cycle start date of each line.

| Residential Electricity Supply energy charges in the window (USD) | Reduction per therm |
|---|---|
| 1200.00 or more | 0.0060 |
| 600.00 to 1199.99 | 0.0030 |
| below 600.00 | none |

### Worked cases (hypothetical ledgers; enrollment date 15 October 2025)

- Electricity energy lines of cycles starting from 16 October 2024 onward total 1180.40, and service fee lines total 71.40: only the 1180.40 counts, so the reduction is 0.0030.
- The same ledger with a further energy line of 25.00 in the window: 1205.40, reduction 0.0060.
- A customer with no Residential Electricity Supply energy charges in the window: no reduction.
- An energy line whose cycle starts 15 October 2024 is outside the window and is not counted.
